files.reason: All Phase 2 DTOs in one file: CreateOfferEnrichmentBodyDto, UpdateOfferEnrichmentBodyDto, ListOfferEnrichmentsQueryDto, CreateContentDraftBodyDto, UpdateContentDraftBodyDto, ListContentDraftsQueryDto, ContentDraftTransitionBodyDto, and TypeScript interfaces.
Creates/list/get/updates offer enrichments as COMPLETED CONTENT_PIPELINE AiRun records. Gate: only APPROVED ProductDrafts accepted.
REST controller for offer enrichments: GET/POST /admin/affiliate-ai-os/offer-enrichments, GET/PATCH /admin/affiliate-ai-os/offer-enrichments/:id.
Creates/list/get/updates/approves/rejects content drafts via ArticleDraft reuse. No publish. isPhase2Draft guard filters by sourceOfferEnrichmentId in outline. Slug deterministic with suffix.
REST controller for content drafts: GET/POST/PATCH, approve, reject. No publish endpoint. Protected by AdminApiKeyGuard.
Unit tests for OfferEnrichmentsService: create (APPROVED gate), list, get, update.
Unit tests for OfferEnrichmentsController: routing, guard, request validation.
Unit tests for ContentDraftsService: create (article-only), list, get, update, approve, reject, idempotency, isPhase2Draft guard.
Unit tests for ContentDraftsController: routing, guards, no-publish verification, approve/reject transitions.
Three new dashboard panels: Ready for Enrichment, Offer Enrichments, Article Drafts / Content Queue. No publish/schedule controls.
Arabic translations for Phase 2 labels: readyForEnrichment, offerEnrichments, articleDrafts, and all status/action labels.
English translations for Phase 2 labels: readyForEnrichment, offerEnrichments, articleDrafts, and all status/action labels.

Phase 2 implementation documentation covering scope, out-of-scope, data flow, APIs, dashboard changes, approval rules, no-publish rule, known limitations, testing instructions, and Phase 3 candidates.
